blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Benchmarks are essential for evaluating and improving large language models (LLMs). Yet many widely used benchmarks are redundant, making evaluation unnecessarily expensive. Benchmark compression lowers this cost by estimating full-benchmark scores and rankings from a partial evaluation. Research in this area has grown rapidly since 2024, but to our knowledge no survey has systematically organized its methods and findings. We review 119 papers to explain how methods choose what to evaluate, recover full-benchmark results, and verify their reliability. From this analysis, we develop a taxonomy covering compression within individual benchmarks, across benchmark suites, and during adaptive evaluation, together with work on redundancy and reliability. We compare their information needs, total costs, reliability checks, and limitations. Methods reduce evaluation costs by selecting representative subsets, using cheaper or reusable information, and testing adaptively, but risk poor coverage, inaccurate estimates, and sequential delays. The resulting taxonomy and practical guide help researchers choose, validate, and deploy methods for more efficient and reliable LLM evaluation.
blocks.zh: 基准对于评价和改进大型语言模型至关重要。 然而,许多广泛使用的基准是多余的,使评价不必要地昂贵。 基准压缩通过从部分评价中估算出全基准分数和排名来降低这一成本. 2024年以来,这方面的研究迅速发展,但据我们所知,没有一项调查系统地组织其方法和调查结果。 我们审查119篇论文,解释如何选择评估、恢复全部基准结果并核实其可靠性的方法。 从这一分析中,我们开发了一个分类学,涵盖单个基准范围内的压缩,跨基准套件的压缩,在适应性评价期间,以及冗余和可靠性方面的工作。 我们比较了他们的信息需求、总成本、可靠性检查和局限性。 方法通过选择具有代表性的子集,使用更便宜或可重复使用的信息,并进行适应性测试来降低评价成本,但有覆盖面差、估计数不准确和相继延误的风险。 由此产生的分类和实用指南帮助研究人员选择、验证和部署方法,以进行更有效和可靠的LLM评价。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Recently, a growing number of benchmarks have been introduced to evaluate and improve large language models (LLMs) ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ; Hendrycks et al., 2021 ) . Yet many of these benchmarks contain substantial redundancy. Evidence from prior studies on widely used benchmarks such as LongBench, GSM8K, and MMLU shows that fewer than 20% of the test samples can preserve results close to those of the full set ( Polo et al., 2024b ; Huang et al., 2025 ) . This redundancy makes LLM evaluation unnecessarily expensive and slows model development. To address this issue, benchmark compression methods aim to reduce evaluation cost while producing results close to those of the full evaluation ( Polo et al., 2024b ; Saranathan et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025 ; Vivek et al., 2024 ) .

Existing studies approach efficient evaluation in different ways and rely on different information, cost assumptions, and validation methods. These differences make the literature difficult to navigate and its methods difficult to compare. Researchers therefore lack clear guidance on which method fits their setting, which costs it actually reduces, and whether its results remain reliable in practice.

blocks.en: In this survey, we review 119 papers to analyze how benchmark compression methods choose what to evaluate and recover full-benchmark performance from partial evaluations. Based on this analysis, we organize the literature into Single-Benchmark Compression, Cross-Benchmark Compression, Adaptive Evaluation, and Benchmark Analysis and Foundations. We then compare these different types of methods in depth, examining what information they use, what they cost in practice, how they are tested, and where they fail. Across the literature, methods reduce costs through representative subsets, cheaper or reusable information, and adaptive testing. Their main risks are poor coverage, inaccurate estimates, and sequential delays. Finally, we discuss the field’s key challenges and future research directions. Together, these analyses provide a foundation for advancing benchmark compression and efficient LLM evaluation. We summarize our contributions as follows:
blocks.zh: 在这次调查中,我们审查了119篇论文,以分析基准压缩方法如何选择评价和从部分评价中恢复全部基准业绩。 基于这一分析,我们把文献组织成"单本马克压缩","跨本克压缩","适应性评价","基准分析和基础". 然后我们对这些不同类型的方法进行深入的比较,研究它们使用何种信息,实际成本如何,测试方式如何,以及失败之处. 在整个文献中,方法通过具有代表性的子集、更便宜或可重复使用的信息以及适应性测试来降低成本。 它们的主要风险是覆盖率低、估计不准确和连续拖延。 最后,我们讨论了该领域的主要挑战和今后的研究方向。 这些分析共同为推进基准压缩和高效的LLM评价打下基础. 我们的贡献总结如下:

blocks.en: • First systematic survey and taxonomy. To our knowledge, we provide the first systematic survey of LLM benchmark compression, synthesizing 119 papers under a common definition and introducing a principled taxonomy and decision path that organize the field by evaluation setting and available information. • Cross-family synthesis and guidance. We compare method families in depth to clarify their requirements, reliability, and limitations, providing guidance for method selection and validation and a roadmap for future research.

blocks.en: 2.2 Taxonomy Overview
blocks.zh: 2.2 分类学概览

blocks.en: We classify each paper by asking three questions in order. Contribution type. Is the paper’s primary contribution an operational cost-reduction method or foundational analysis of benchmark evaluation and compression? Papers in the latter group form Benchmark Analysis and Foundations. Subset selection. Is the evaluated subset fixed before evaluation begins, or is it selected dynamically during evaluation? The former is static benchmark compression, and the latter is Adaptive Evaluation. Adaptive methods divide into Adaptive Item Selection, which chooses the next item, and Sequential Decision and Stopping, which governs the terminal action. Scope and information. A static method is Cross-Benchmark Compression when it jointly reduces several benchmark evaluations and Single-Benchmark Compression otherwise. Single-Benchmark Compression has three subtypes based on the information used to select items. Content-Based Compression uses benchmark-side information, Historical-Response Compression adds responses from earlier models, and Target-Conditioned Compression adds a cheap signal from the model being evaluated. Because the taxonomy is hierarchical, fixed versus dynamic subset selection is considered before benchmark scope. Scope distinguishes only methods whose evaluated subsets are fixed in advance. Each paper therefore receives one primary label based on its main contribution and evaluation design, while other properties are recorded as secondary attributes. This hierarchy provides a consistent framework for navigating the literature and comparing methods. Figure 2 and 3 show the survey framework and taxonomy, respectively. Appendix C gives the formal definitions and classification rules, and Appendix C.5 covers hybrid and boundary cases. The following sections review the work in each category in detail.

blocks.en: 3 Static Benchmark Compression
blocks.zh: 3 静态基准压缩

blocks.en: Static Benchmark Compression fixes the evaluation subset before the main evaluation begins. Methods that reduce one benchmark form Single-Benchmark Compression, as illustrated in Figure 4 , whereas methods that reduce several benchmarks together form Cross-Benchmark Compression.
blocks.zh: 静态基准压缩在主要评价开始前就固定评价子集. 如图4所示,减少一个基准构成单一-奔驰压缩的方法,而减少若干基准共同构成Cross-奔驰压缩的方法。

blocks.en: 3.1 Single-Benchmark Compression
blocks.zh: 3.1 单倍径压缩

blocks.en:
Single-Benchmark Compression evaluates a model on a fixed subset of one benchmark and uses the subset results to estimate its full-benchmark score or ranking. Based on the information used to select the subset, we divide these methods into three groups. Content-Based Compression uses sampling rules or item data, Historical-Response Compression uses results from previously evaluated models, and Target-Conditioned Compression uses a cheap signal from the current model.
Table 1 compares representative methods across groups.
The following subsections discuss each group further.

blocks.en: 3.1.1 Content-Based Compression
blocks.zh: 3.1.1 基于内容的压缩

blocks.en: Content-Based Compression builds the subset from a sampling rule or item information such as text, metadata, and representations.
blocks.zh: 基于内容的压缩从一个采样规则或诸如文本、元数据和表述等项目信息中构建子集。

blocks.en: Content-Based Compression ranges from simple sampling to content-guided selection. Random and stratified sampling use sample means or group weights. PromptEval extends structured sampling to sparse prompt-by-example cells and predicts the missing cells ( Polo et al., 2024a ) . Coreset methods group items by text, required skills, or reasoning, then aggregate selected representatives directly, with cluster weights, or with predictions for untested items ( Kjorvezir et al., 2026 ; Bean et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Pan et al., 2026 ) . Auxiliary scores provide another route. Content-guided probability sampling favors informative items and corrects selection with inverse-probability weighting, while calibrated-judge methods use a small human-labeled subset to correct many automated judgments ( Purificato et al., 2026 ; Saad-Falcon et al., 2024 ; Divekar, 2026 ; Feng et al., 2026 ) . None of these methods requires a historical model-by-item response matrix.
blocks.zh: 基于内容的压缩从简单的取样到内容指导的选择不等. 随机和分层抽样使用抽样手段或组分权重。 提示 Eval将结构化采样扩展到稀有的逐个样本细胞并预测缺失的细胞(Polo等,2024a.). Coreset方法将物品按文字,所需技能,或推理进行分组,然后直接汇总选定代表,并有集群权重,或对未经测试的物品进行预测(Kjorvezir等,2026;Bean等,2025;Wang等,2025b;Pan等,2026). 辅助分数提供另一种路线. 内容引导概率采样有利于信息性项目并用反概率权重来纠正选择,而校正判断方法则使用人标小子集来纠正许多自动判断(Purificato等,2026;Saad-Falcon等,2024;Divekar等,2026;Feng等,2026). 这些方法都不需要一个历史的逐项模型响应矩阵.

blocks.en: Content-Based Compression has low construction cost. Random and stratified sampling require little setup cost, while representation-based methods avoid collecting a large and expensive model-by-item response matrix. However, small random subsets can have high variance, and items that appear diverse in text or embedding space may still test similar abilities. Using less information can therefore make full-benchmark recovery less stable or accurate. At the same time, weaker reliance on historical response patterns may improve robustness when model behavior shifts.
blocks.zh: 基于内容的压缩工程造价较低. 随机和分层取样需要很少的设置成本,而基于代表性的方法则避免收集一个大型和昂贵的逐项模型反应矩阵。 然而,小的随机子集可能具有高差异,文本或嵌入空间中出现多样性的项目仍然可能测试类似的能力. 因此,如果使用较少的信息,就可能使全部基准回收稳定性或准确性降低。 与此同时,在模型行为转变时,对历史反应模式的依赖度更弱,可能提高稳健性.

blocks.en: 3.1.2 Historical-Response Compression
blocks.zh: 3.1.2 历史反应压制

blocks.en: Historical-Response Compression reuses past evaluation results to reduce the cost of testing new models. These results form a model-by-item response matrix that records each model’s performance on each item. Methods use these patterns to select representative or informative items.
blocks.zh: 历史反应压缩再利用过去的评价结果来降低测试新模型的成本. 这些结果形成了一个逐项反应模型,记录每个模型在每个项目上的性能. 采用这些模式选择具有代表性或资料性的项目的方法。

blocks.en: Historical responses can guide item coverage, learned recovery, or statistical correction. Coverage and psychometric methods cluster items by response patterns or fit item response theory models, then recover the full score with cluster weights or an estimated ability ( Vivek et al., 2024 ; Polo et al., 2024b ; Huang et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026b ) . Learned-recovery methods treat selected responses as features and predict the full score or missing item results ( Saranathan et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ; Zhang et al., 2026b ; Fisch et al., 2026 ) . Model-assisted methods retain randomized target sampling and use residual or inverse-probability correction to keep the estimate tied to the original item pool ( Zhang et al., 2025a ; Fisch et al., 2026 ; Berrada et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2026 ) . Historical filtering is a boundary case. It keeps difficult or discriminative items and scores the refined benchmark directly rather than reconstructing the original full score ( Gupta et al., 2025 ; Joshi et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ) . Each approach relies on historical patterns transferring to the new model.
blocks.zh: 历史反应可以指导项目覆盖,学习到的恢复,或者统计更正. 覆盖面和心理计量方法按反应模式或适配项目反应理论模型将项目分组,然后用集分权重或估计能力恢复全部得分(Vivek等人,2024年;Polo等人,2024年b;Huang等人,2025年;Wang等人,2026年b)。 张等,2026b; Fisch等,2026.). 模型辅助方法保留随机化的目标取样,并使用剩余或逆概率校正,使估计数与原项目池挂钩(Zhang等,2025a; Fisch等,2026;Berrada等,2025;Liu等,2026;). 历史过滤是一个边界案例。 它保留了困难或有区别的项目,直接对被完善的基准进行分数,而不是重建原来的满分(Gupta等,2025;Joshi等,2026;Zhang等,2025b.). 每一种方法都依赖于向新模式转移的历史模式。

blocks.en: Historical results may support smaller subsets or more accurate full-score estimates than item data alone. However, building the response matrix requires many full evaluations unless public results are available. Moreover, under large model shifts, such as substantial performance gains, their advantage may shrink and random sampling can remain competitive ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) . Broad historical coverage is therefore important for generalization. Target-Conditioned Compression reduces this dependence by using signals from the current model.
blocks.zh: 历史结果可能支持小子集或比仅项目数据更准确的全分数估计. 然而,除非有公开成果,否则建立反应矩阵需要许多全面的评价。 此外,在大的模型转变,如大幅度的性能提高的情况下,其优势可能会收缩,随机抽样可以保持竞争力(Zhang等,2025a.)。 因此,广泛的历史覆盖面对于概括十分重要。 目标有条件 压缩通过使用当前模型的信号来减少这种依赖性.

blocks.en: 3.1.3 Target-Conditioned Compression
blocks.zh: 3.1.3 有目标的压缩

blocks.en: Target-Conditioned Compression uses a low-cost signal from the current model, such as probe results or confidence scores, to select its subset before the main evaluation. Different models can therefore receive different fixed subsets.
blocks.zh: 目标有条件的压缩使用从当前模型得到的低成本信号,如探测结果或信心分数,在主评价前选择其子集. 因此,不同的模型可以接收不同的固定子集.

blocks.en: The current-model signal may guide a probe, direct item selection, or proxy correction. Probe-based methods evaluate a small shared set, identify similar historical models, and use them to build a tailored subset and predict untested items ( Yuan et al., 2025 ) . Uncertainty- and disagreement-based methods favor items on which the current model is unsure or the candidates differ. Weighted sampling recovers the full score, while selected pairwise comparisons produce a winner or ranking ( Ramakrishnan et al., 2026 ; Feng et al., 2025 ; Tahan et al., 2024 ) . Proxy-correction methods score the full pool with a cheap judge and send a small fixed subset to humans. The human labels audit the judge or correct the final estimate, sometimes with more reviews assigned to likely judge errors ( Unell et al., 2026 ; Unell et al., 2025 ; Kim, 2026 ; Angelopoulos et al., 2025 ; Boyeau et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 当前模式的信号可能引导探测器,直接选择物品,或代理修正. 基于探测的方法评价一个小的共享集,确定相似的历史模型,并用它们来构建一个量身定制的子集并预测未经测试的项目(袁等,2025. 基于不确定性和分歧的方法有利于目前模式不确定或候选人不同的项目。 加权采样恢复了满分,而选定的对等比较则产生得分或排名(Ramakrishnan等,2026;Feng等,2025;Tahan等,2024)。 代理校正方法用廉价的裁判员来给全池打分,再将一个小的固定子集发送给人类. 人类标签对法官进行审计或更正最终估计,有时对可能的判决错误进行更多的审查(Unell等人,2026;Unell等人,2025;Kim,2026;Angelopoulos等人,2025;Boyeau等人,2025)。

blocks.en: Target-Conditioned Compression tailors the subset to the current model while retaining parallel batch execution. It is useful only when the probe or proxy is much cheaper than the tests or reviews saved, so its full cost must include output scans and cheap judge calls. Weak signals can miss important items or introduce systematic proxy errors. Random coverage and paired human checks provide safeguards. Judge-based methods often save human or strong-judge reviews rather than model inference, so the saved unit should be stated clearly.
blocks.zh: 目标有条件的压缩使子集适应了目前的模型,同时保留了平行的批量执行. 只有当探测器或代理器比所保存的测试或审查要便宜得多时,它才有用,因此其全部成本必须包括输出扫描和廉价的法官呼叫. 弱信号可能错过重要项目或引入系统性代理错误. 随机覆盖和配对人体检查提供了保障。 以法官为基础的方法往往节省人力或强力法官的审查,而不是模型推论,因此应清楚说明所节省的单位.

blocks.en: 3.2 Cross-Benchmark Compression
blocks.zh: 3.2 跨奔驰压缩

blocks.en: Single benchmark compression reduces redundancy within a single benchmark. Benchmark suites can also be redundant because different benchmarks often test similar abilities. Cross-Benchmark Compression selects a smaller set from across the suite and uses its results to estimate the full set of benchmark scores or the suite ranking.
blocks.zh: 单一基准压缩减少单一基准内的冗余. 基准套房也可能是多余的,因为不同的基准往往测试相似的能力. Cross-Benchmark Compress从整个套间中选择了更小的一套,并利用其结果来估计完整的一套基准分数或套间排名.

blocks.en: Cross-Benchmark Compression can remove items, complete benchmarks, or expensive target tasks. Suite-anchor methods select informative items across benchmarks and use shared ability models to recover individual scores, a suite average, or a ranking ( Kipnis et al., 2025 ; Liao et al., 2025 ; Habba et al., 2026 ) . Benchmark-selection methods run only a few complete tasks and use score-matrix completion to predict the skipped benchmark scores ( Zeng and Papailiopoulos, 2026 ; Subramani et al., 2025 ; Maimon et al., 2026 ) . Source-to-target methods replace an expensive benchmark with cheaper proxy tasks, then estimate the target score or ranking through regression or importance weighting ( Song et al., 2026 ; Shi et al., 2025 ) . Multilingual tensor models extend suite-level sharing across languages ( Lior et al., 2026 ) . The saved unit thus grows from individual items to entire benchmark runs or costly environments.
blocks.zh: Cross-Benchmark Conpress可以删除项目,完成基准,或者昂贵的目标任务. 套接力方法选择跨基准的信息项目,并使用共享能力模型来取回个人得分,套接力平均值或排名(Kipnis等,2025;Liao等,2025;Habba等,2026)。 基准选择方法只执行几项完整的任务,并使用分数矩阵完成来预测跳出的基准分数(Zeng和Papailiopoulos,2026;Subramani等,2025;Maimon等,2026)。 源到目标方法用更便宜的代理任务来取代昂贵的基准,然后通过回归或重要性加权来估计目标分数或排名(Song等,2026;Shi等,2025.). 多语种的收音机模型将套接字级共享扩展到了各种语言(Lior等人,2026年). 因此,被节省的单位从单个项目增长到整个基准运行或成本高的环境。

blocks.en: Cross-Benchmark Compression is most useful when one model needs to be evaluated on several benchmarks. Joint compression reduces redundancy both within and across benchmarks, making it more efficient than compressing each benchmark independently. Some methods can even skip complete benchmarks or costly tasks. This sharing also creates the main risk: estimates rely on cross-benchmark relations that may not hold for new models, especially when learned from past suite results. Validation should therefore include unseen models, while unreliable components should be run directly. The next section turns to Adaptive Evaluation, where the subset is not fixed in advance.
blocks.zh: Cross-Benchmark Compression在需要根据几个基准评价一个模型时最为有用. 联合压缩减少了基准内部和跨基准的冗余,使其比独立压缩每个基准更有效. 有些方法甚至可以跳过完整的基准或昂贵的任务. 这种分担也造成了主要的风险:估计数依赖于跨基准关系,而跨基准关系可能无法维持新的模式,特别是在从过去的成套结果中吸取教训时。 因此,验证应包括隐形模型,而不可靠的组件应直接运行。 下一节转向适应性评价,其中子集没有事先固定.

blocks.en: 4 Adaptive Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4 适应性评价

blocks.en:
Adaptive Evaluation uses results collected so far to decide what to test next and when to stop. Adaptive Item Selection chooses the next item to evaluate, while Sequential Decision and Stopping decides whether enough items have been tested.
Table 2 compares representative adaptive methods.
blocks.zh:
适应性评价利用迄今收集的成果,决定下一步测试什么,何时停止。 适应性项目选择选择下一个要评价的项目,而顺序决定和停止则决定是否已经测试了足够的项目.
表2比较了有代表性的适应方法。

blocks.en: 4.1 Adaptive Item Selection
blocks.zh: 4.1 适应性项目选择

blocks.en: Adaptive Item Selection starts with a small set of items. After each response or batch, it updates the score, ability estimate, or uncertainty, then selects the item expected to improve the estimate most.
blocks.zh: 适应性项目选择从一组小项目开始。 每次回复或分批后,它会更新分数,能力估计,或不确定性,然后选择预期最能改进估计的项目.

blocks.en: Adaptive Item Selection chooses the next test through ability estimation, response prediction, or uncertainty-based allocation. Computerized adaptive testing updates an item response theory ability estimate after each answer, selects the most informative next item, and maps the final ability to a score or ranking ( Hofmann et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026c ; Anonymous, 2026 ) . Active matrix completion predicts the target’s untested responses and selects the item expected to improve those predictions most ( Li et al., 2025 ; Encinar et al., 2026 ; Zhong et al., 2025 ) . Other methods direct more tests to uncertain groups, rare failures, or noisy judge cells. Group weights or sampling probabilities correct uneven selection, while repeated-cell means estimate noisy comparisons ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Huang et al., 2026a ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Kim et al., 2026 ; Saha et al., 2026 ) . Unlike static compression, each new result can redirect later tests.
blocks.zh: 适应性项目选择通过能力估计,反应预测或以不确定性为基础的分配选择下一个测试. 计算机化的适应性测试在每个答案后更新一个项目响应理论能力估计,选择信息最丰富的下一个项目,并绘制一个分数或排名的最终能力图(Hofmann等,2025;Li等,2026c;匿名,2026). 积极矩阵完成预测目标未经测试的反应,并选择预期能改善这些预测的项目(Li等,2025;Encinar等,2026;Zhong等,2025)。 其他方法将更多的测试导向不确定的群体,罕见的失败,或吵闹的判断细胞. 群体权重或采样概率纠正了不均匀的选择,而重复细胞则意味着估计噪音比较(Wang等人,2025a; Huang等,2026a;Wu等,2026;Kim等,2026;Saha等,2026; 与静态压缩不同,每个新结果都可以重新定向后期测试.

blocks.en: Adaptive Item Selection can reduce cost by directing later tests to the items that are most informative for the current model. This flexibility has two main costs. Sequential rounds increase wall-clock time and give models different test paths, which complicates direct comparison and reproduction. Adaptive subsets may also no longer represent the full benchmark, so reliable scores depend on suitable correction and, for some methods, well-calibrated historical data. Complete test-path logs are therefore important. Better item selection still does not determine when evaluation should stop, which is the focus of the next subsection.
blocks.zh: 适应性项目选择可以通过将以后的测试引导到对当前模型信息最丰富的项目来降低成本. 这种灵活性有两个主要代价。 相继发弹会增加壁时钟时间并给模型不同的测试路径,使直接比较和复制复杂化. 适应性子集也可能不再代表完整的基准,因此可靠的分数取决于适当的校正,对于一些方法来说,则取决于精确的历史数据. 因此,完整的试验路径日志很重要。 更好的项目选择仍然不能决定何时应停止评价,这是下分节的重点.

blocks.en: 4.2 Sequential Decision and Stopping
blocks.zh: 4.2 顺序决定和停止

blocks.en: Sequential Decision and Stopping evaluates items in stages and checks after each stage whether more testing is needed. It may target a score with a requested precision, a reliable pairwise comparison, or the best model under a fixed budget. It may also accept, reject, escalate, or abstain.
blocks.zh: 顺序决定和停止会分阶段评价物品,并在每个阶段后检查是否需要更多的测试. 它可以以所要求的精确度、可靠的双向比较或固定预算下的最佳模型为目标。 它还可以接受、拒绝、升级或弃权。

blocks.en: Sequential methods save cost by stopping at a target precision, focusing a fixed budget on likely winners, or avoiding unnecessary comparisons. Staged methods stop when a score interval, rank, or pairwise difference reaches the required level, while anytime-valid methods allow checking after every result ( Perlitz et al., 2024 ; Balkır et al., 2026 ; Arviv et al., 2026 ; Zhou et al., 2026b ; Li et al., 2026b ) . Best-model bandits concentrate tests on plausible winners and eliminate weak candidates, sometimes using shared queries or matrix predictions ( Zhou et al., 2025a ; Lyu et al., 2026 ; Tolochinsky et al., 2026 ) . Selective-decision methods route easy cases to cheap judges, escalate uncertain ones, or use partial tasks and tournaments to return a promotion decision, abstention, or ranking ( Huang and Shen, 2026 ; Jung et al., 2025 ; Son et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 顺序方法通过停止目标精确,将固定预算的重点放在可能的赢家上,或者避免不必要的比较来节省成本. 分阶段方法在得分间隔、分级或对等差达到规定水平时停止,而随时有效的方法则允许在每次结果之后进行核对(Perlitz等,2024;Balkır等,2026;Arviv等,2026;Zhou等,2026b;Li等,2026b)。 最佳模式的土匪将测试集中在可能胜出者身上,并消灭弱者,有时使用共享查询或矩阵预测(周等,2025a; Lyu等, 2026; Tolochinsky等, 2026). 选择性决定方法将容易的案件引导给廉价的法官,使不确定的案件升级,或者利用部分任务和联赛来退回升级决定,弃权,或排名(黄和沈,2026;郑等,2025;宋等,2025.

blocks.en: The main advantage of sequential methods is that they spend evaluation effort where it can still change the result. They can stop once a score is precise enough or a comparison is settled, while fixed-budget methods can focus tests on competitive models. Their savings, however, depend on difficulty. Close models may require almost the full benchmark, and fixed-budget methods redistribute rather than reduce the budget. They may also return only a winner or decision instead of full scores. Reliable early stopping requires a valid sequential rule. Staged execution can also increase wall-clock time and requires complete logs for reproduction.
blocks.zh: 相继方法的主要优点是,它们把评价工作花在仍能改变结果的地方。 一旦一个分数足够精确或比较确定后,它们就可以停止,而固定预算方法可以把测试的重点放在竞争模型上。 然而,他们的储蓄取决于困难。 接近的模式可能需要几乎完全的基准,固定预算方法可以重新分配而不是削减预算。 他们还可能只返回赢家或决定,而不是满分。 可靠的早期停止需要一个有效的相继规则. 分期执行也可以增加墙点时间并需要完整的日志来复制.

blocks.en: 5 Benchmark Analysis and Foundations
blocks.zh: 5 基准分析和基础

blocks.en: Having reviewed the main benchmark compression methods, we now turn to foundational studies that examine four questions underlying these methods.
blocks.zh: 在审查了主要的基准压缩方法之后,我们现在转向基础研究,研究这些方法背后的四个问题。

blocks.en: Many benchmarks can be compressed because their items measure overlapping capabilities and provide limited additional discrimination among models. In a model-by-item response matrix, this redundancy appears as correlated model responses, low item discrimination, and low effective dimensionality ( Ghosh et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025c ; Qu et al., 2026 ; Sha and Zhao, 2026 ) . This structure allows smaller subsets to retain information needed for score or ranking recovery. However, redundancy depends on the evaluated models and the target result. A subset that preserves an overall ranking may still distort score gaps or reverse close models.
blocks.zh: 许多基准可以压缩,因为其项目衡量的是重叠的能力,在模型之间提供了有限的额外区别。 在一个逐项答复模型中,这种重复性表现为相互关联的模型反应、低项目歧视和低有效维度(Ghosh等人,2025年;Zhang等人,2025年c;Qu等人,2026年;Sha和Zha,2026年)。 这种结构允许较小的子集保留分数或排名恢复所需的信息. 然而,冗余取决于评价模型和目标结果。 保留总体排名的子集仍然可能扭曲得分差距或倒置的近似模型.

blocks.en: There is no universally safe compression ratio across benchmarks. Item response models need suitable calibration models and stable item parameters, whose uncertainty can affect selection and model comparisons ( Li et al., 2026a ; Jiang et al., 2026 ; Mandujano Reyes, 2026 ) . The required item count also depends on the score difference of interest, paired variance, task-group coverage, and allowed error rate ( Huang, 2026 ; Yauney et al., 2026 ; Kotawala, 2026 ; Miller, 2024 ) . Random sampling can remain competitive with more complex selectors. When retained items cannot reliably separate two models, their comparison should remain unresolved.
blocks.zh: 基准之间没有普遍安全的压缩率。 项目反应模型需要适当的校正模型和稳定的项目参数,其不确定性会影响选择和模型比较(Li等人,2026a; Jiang等, 2026; Mandujano Reyes, 2026). . 所需项目计分还取决于分数差的利息,配对差异,任务组覆盖,以及允许出错率(黄,2026;Yauney等,2026;Kotawala,2026;Miller,2024). 随机采样可以保持与更复杂的选取者的竞争. 如果保留的项目无法可靠地将两种模式分开,它们的比较就应保持不变。

blocks.en: Full and compressed evaluations should use the same judges, prompts, decoding settings, and agent harnesses. Aggregate judge accuracy can hide local errors, and removing weaker judges can discard useful signals ( Li, 2026 ; Gupta and Kumar, 2026 ; Landesberg, 2026 ) . Prompt and harness changes can also alter model comparisons ( Lior et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026c ) . Any protocol change should therefore be assessed separately from compression.
blocks.zh: 完全和压缩的评价应使用相同的判断、提示、解码设置和代理工具。 综合法官的准确性可以隐藏局部错误,去除较弱的法官可以丢弃有用的信号(Li, 2026;Gupta和Kumar, 2026;Landesberg, 2026. 迅速和利用变化也可改变模型比较(Lior等,2025;Zhang等,2026c.)。 因此,任何协议变更都应与压缩分开评估。

blocks.en: Not every smaller benchmark is intended to reproduce the original result. Some methods remove questions whose answers can be guessed from option wording or whose outcomes conflict with the intended capability ordering ( Cao et al., 2026 ; Qian et al., 2026 ) . Their goal is to build a cleaner benchmark, even if model scores or rankings change. This is benchmark repair rather than score reconstruction. Compression asks whether fewer evaluations can reproduce the original result, while repair asks whether that result should remain the target. A repaired benchmark may be smaller and cheaper, but it must be validated as a new benchmark.
blocks.zh: 并不是每个较小的基准都旨在复制原始结果。 有些方法排除了从选项措辞中可以猜出答案或结果与预期能力命令相冲突的问题(Cao等,2026;Qian等,2026.). 他们的目标是建立一个更清洁的基准,即使模型得分或排名发生变化. 这是基准修复,而不是重建。 压缩质问评价减少能否复制原始结果,而修复质问该结果是否仍应作为目标. 修复后的基准可能较小并更便宜,但必须作为新的基准加以验证。

blocks.en: 6 Comparison Across Method Families
blocks.zh: 6 不同方法家庭的比较

blocks.en: We next compare the six compression families to guide method choice. We focus on subset selection, score recovery, lifecycle cost and limitations. Appendix D gives the detailed comparison.
blocks.zh: 接下来我们比较六个压缩家族来指导方法的选择. 我们侧重于子集选择、分数恢复、生命周期成本和限制。 附录D提供了详细的比较。

blocks.en: 6.1 Subset Selection: Information and Timing
blocks.zh: 6.1 子集选择:信息和时间

blocks.en:
Content-Based and Historical-Response Compression select a fixed subset before testing the target model. The former uses benchmark data, while the latter uses responses from earlier models.
Target-Conditioned Compression first collects a cheap signal from the current model and then fixes a target-specific batch. Cross-Benchmark Compression shares information across benchmarks and selects in advance.
Adaptive Item Selection uses each new target result to choose the next item, while Sequential Decision and Stopping uses interim results to decide whether more testing is needed ( Vivek et al., 2024 ; Yuan et al., 2025 ; Kipnis et al., 2025 ; Hofmann et al., 2025 ; Zhou et al., 2026b ) . Using later and more target-specific information can improve selection, but reduces reuse and parallelism.
blocks.zh:
基于内容和历史反应的压缩在测试目标模型之前选择一个固定子集. 前者使用基准数据,而后者使用早期模型的答复.
目标可控压缩首先从目前的模型中收集出廉价的信号,然后修正一个特定目标批次. Cross-Benchmark Compress 跨基准共享信息并提前选择.
适应性项目选择使用每个新目标结果来选择下一个项目,而顺序决定和停止则使用临时结果来决定是否需要更多的测试(Vivek等,2024;Yuan等,2025;Kipnis等,2025;Hofmann等,2025;周等,2026b). 使用后期和更有针对性的信息可以改进选择,但可以减少再利用和平行性.

blocks.en: 6.2 Recovering the Full Result
blocks.zh: 6.2 收回全部结果

blocks.en: Random and stratified samples support recovery through means or group weights. A deterministic coreset score may instead describe a new short form. Inverse-probability weighting targets the original pool when sampling probabilities are known, though uneven weights increase variance. Historical predictors can recover untested results but depend on transfer to new models ( Purificato et al., 2026 ; Polo et al., 2024b ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) . Residual or gold-label correction reduces dependence on prediction accuracy under suitable sampling conditions ( Zhang et al., 2025a ; Fisch et al., 2026 ) . Sequential methods may return only a winner, rank tier, or threshold decision. Comparisons must therefore match the recovered result.
blocks.zh: 随机和分层的样本支持通过手段或组重进行回收。 确定性核心集得分可以相反地描述出一种新的短表. 反概率权重在已知采样概率时针对原始池,尽管不均匀权重会增加差异. 历史预测器可以恢复未经测试的结果,但取决于向新模型的转移(Purificato等,2026;Polo等,2024b;Zhang等,2026a)。 残余物或金标签的校正降低了在适当采样条件下对预测精度的依赖性(Zhang等人,2025a;Fisch等人,2026 )。 顺序方法只能返回赢家、等级或门槛决定。 因此,比较必须与回收结果相符。

blocks.en: 6.3 Lifecycle Cost
blocks.zh: 6.3 生命周期费用

blocks.en: Lifecycle cost includes subset construction, target-side signals, expensive tests, score recovery, updates, and latency. Content-Based methods avoid building a historical response matrix, although full-pool embeddings or reasoning traces still add cost. Historical-Response and Cross-Benchmark methods have higher construction and update costs, but low cost per new target when the same benchmark or suite is used repeatedly. Target-Conditioned methods pay for a probe, output scan, or cheap judge on every target, so the signal must be much cheaper than the tests or labels it removes ( Polo et al., 2024b ; Subramani et al., 2025 ; Unell et al., 2025 ) . Adaptive methods add serial rounds, while sequential stopping is cheap for clear cases but may approach full evaluation for close models. Item count, model calls, human review, judge calls, and wall-clock time should therefore be reported separately. Appendix D.4 gives the detailed breakdown.

blocks.en: 6.4 Limitations and Method Choice
blocks.zh: 6.4 限制和方法选择

blocks.en:
Sections 3 and 4 discuss the limitations of each family, with further analysis in Appendices E and D . These limitations guide method choice alongside the available information and required result. For a single benchmark, consider Content-Based methods when only item data are available, Historical-Response methods when past evaluation records are available, and Target-Conditioned methods when a cheap, useful target signal is available. Cross-Benchmark Compression suits related benchmarks evaluated jointly. Consider Adaptive Item Selection when serial rounds are acceptable and the score estimator accounts for how items are selected. Sequential Decision and Stopping requires a valid stopping rule and may save little for close models ( Zhang et al., 2025a ; Jiang et al., 2026 ; Arviv et al., 2026 ; Zhou et al., 2026b ) .
When a method’s requirements are not met, use broader random sampling, test unsupported tasks directly, continue evaluation, or abstain. Appendix D.6 summarizes these checks and choices.

blocks.en: 7 Challenges and Future Directions
blocks.zh: 7 挑战与未来方向

blocks.en: Beyond statistical reliability, benchmark compression must also generalize to future models and gain broader adoption in the evaluation community.
blocks.zh: 除了统计可靠性外,基准压缩还必须通向未来的模型,并获得评价界更广泛的采用。

blocks.en: Many compressed subsets are selected using response records from existing models. Models from other families and newer, more capable models may show different response patterns, which may reduce the subset’s coverage and discrimination. Future work should develop compression methods that transfer more reliably across models and over time. Compressed benchmarks should also be tested on newly released models and updated through periodic or continuous refresh mechanisms when their coverage or discrimination declines.
blocks.zh: 许多被压缩的子集是利用现有模型的响应记录来选择的. 其他家庭的模型和较新的、能力较强的模型可能显示不同的反应模式,这可能减少子集的覆盖面和歧视。 今后的工作应制定压缩方法,使模型之间和一段时间内更可靠地转移。 压缩的基准也应在新发布的模型上进行测试,并在覆盖或歧视减少时通过定期或连续更新机制加以更新。

blocks.en: Although studies have found redundancy in established benchmarks, full results remain necessary for comparison with leaderboards and prior work. Researchers therefore often need to run complete evaluations for formal reporting. Compression still reduces costs during model iteration, screening, and repeated validation. A promising direction is to combine compression with benchmark repair and release a recalibrated version that removes flawed, redundant, overly easy, or weakly discriminating items. This could lower cost while improving discrimination among stronger models, providing a cheaper and more informative shared reference.
blocks.zh: 虽然研究发现,既定基准中存在冗余,但与领导板和先前的工作进行比较,仍然需要取得全部结果。 因此,研究人员往往需要为正式报告进行完整的评价。 压缩仍会降低模型迭代,筛选,再三验证期间的成本. 一个有希望的方向是将压缩与基准修补结合起来,并发布一个重新校正的版本,删除有缺陷的,多余的,过于容易的,或者微弱的歧视性的项目. 这样做可以降低成本,同时改善更强大的模式之间的歧视,提供一个更便宜和更翔实的共同参考。

blocks.en: For new benchmarks, compression should be integrated into benchmark construction before release. The public version should use a compact but informative item set that covers the intended model capabilities from the outset, rather than publishing a large redundant benchmark and compressing it later. This compression by design can accelerate evaluation and model iteration while reducing unnecessary computational and environmental costs.
blocks.zh: 对于新的基准,压缩应在发布前纳入基准建设. 公开版应使用一套紧凑但内容翔实的项目,从一开始就涵盖预期的模型能力,而不是公布大量冗余基准并随后加以压缩。 这种通过设计压缩可以加快评价和模型迭代,同时降低不必要的计算和环境成本.

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: In this survey, we introduced a unified taxonomy for benchmark compression in LLM evaluation. We also compared method families by their information needs, costs, and reliability. Our analysis shows that methods reduce costs by evaluating representative items, using cheaper or reusable information to estimate omitted results, and focusing further evaluation on uncertain cases. Reliable compression requires sufficient coverage, accurate recovery, and valid adaptive decisions. More broadly, efficient evaluation should collect useful information at lower cost while preserving reliable results.
blocks.zh: 在本次调查中,我们在LLM评价中引入了用于基准压缩的统一分类. 我们还根据家庭的信息需求、成本和可靠性对方法进行了比较。 我们的分析表明,各种方法通过评价具有代表性的项目、使用更便宜或可重复使用的信息来估计省略结果并侧重于不确定情况来降低成本。 可靠的压缩需要充分的覆盖、准确的恢复和有效的适应决定。 更广泛地说,有效的评价应该以更低的成本收集有用的信息,同时保持可靠的结果。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: This survey has three limitations. First, it covers work only through August 2026, so subsequent studies are not included. We will continue to update the survey as new research appears. Second, space constraints and the rapid growth of benchmark compression prevent the main text from describing every method in detail. We therefore focus on a high-level taxonomy and roadmap that help readers quickly understand the field as a whole, its main method families, and their relationships. Appendix E provides detailed descriptions of representative methods, while Appendix D presents in-depth comparisons across method families. Third, studies use widely different evaluation settings, making their results difficult to compare or combine quantitatively. Fortunately, our common formulation and comparison framework make these differences explicit, supporting more consistent reporting and future quantitative synthesis.
blocks.zh: 这项调查有三个局限性。 首先,它只涵盖2026年8月之前的工作,因此之后的研究不包括在内. 随着新的研究的出现,我们将继续更新调查。 第二,空间限制和基准压缩的快速增长使得正文无法详细描述每一种方法. 因此,我们把重点放在一个高层次的分类学和路线图上,帮助读者迅速了解整个领域、其主要方法家族及其关系。 附 录 E提供了代表性方法的详细说明,而附录D则提供了方法家族的深度比较. 第三,研究使用大相径庭的评价环境,使其结果难以在数量上进行比较或结合. 所幸的是,我们的共同拟订和比较框架明确了这些差异,支持更加一致地提交报告和今后进行定量综合。

blocks.en: To assess whether this field had been surveyed previously, we supplemented the literature search in Appendix F with survey-focused queries. We combined survey and review with terms related to efficient evaluation, benchmark selection, psychometrics, adaptive testing, benchmark quality, and automated judging, and traced backward and forward citations. By the August 9, 2026 cutoff, we found surveys of related areas, but none that organizes LLM benchmark compression as a unified field covering compression within individual benchmarks, across benchmark suites, and during adaptive evaluation, together with work on redundancy and reliability. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first systematic survey to synthesize this rapidly growing field within a common framework. Our taxonomy and cross-family comparison clarify how the methods relate, what information and costs they require, and how their reliability should be assessed. Prior surveys cover only parts of this scope, as shown in Tables 8 and 9 .
blocks.zh: 为了评估这个领域以前是否进行过调查,我们用以调查为重点的查询来补充附录F中的文献检索。 我们把调查和审查与高效评价、基准选择、心理计量、适应性测试、基准质量和自动判断等术语结合起来,并追溯到前后引用。 到2026年8月9日截取时,我们发现相关领域的调查,但没有任何一个将LLM基准压缩组织为一个统一的领域,涵盖单个基准范围内的压缩,跨基准套间,以及适应性评价期间,同时涉及冗余和可靠性的工作. 据我们所知,这是第一次在一个共同框架内综合这一迅速增长的领域的系统调查。 我们的分类和跨家庭比较澄清了方法之间的关系、它们需要哪些信息和成本以及应如何评估其可靠性。 如表8和表9所示,以前的调查只涵盖这一范围的一部分。

blocks.en: B.1 Adjacent Methodological Surveys
blocks.zh: B.1 相邻方法调查

blocks.en: The closest methodological surveys represent three related traditions. LLM Psychometrics covers construct measurement, instrument design, and validation for LLMs ( Ye et al., 2025 ) . The survey of computerized adaptive testing reviews response models, item selection, test control, and stopping beyond the LLM setting ( Zhuang et al., 2026 ) . The LLM-as-a-Judge survey focuses on scalable model-based judging and its reliability ( Gu et al., 2026 ) . Table 8 compares them using general methodological dimensions independent of our taxonomy. These surveys cover only parts of our scope, whereas our survey connects fixed test reduction, adaptive testing, joint benchmark use, cost analysis, and reliability in a unified framework for LLM evaluation.
blocks.zh: 最近的方法学调查代表了三种相关的传统。 LLM 语言 心理计量学涵盖LLMs的构造测量、仪器设计和验证(Ye等人,2025年)。 计算机化适应性测试调查审查响应模型,项目选择,测试控制,并停止超LLM设置( Zhu等,2026. LLM-as-a-Judge调查侧重于基于可扩展模型的判断及其可靠性(Gu等,2026年)。 表8用与我们的分类无关的一般方法进行对比。 这些调查只涵盖我们范围的一部分,而我们的调查则将固定的减少测试、适应性测试、联合基准使用、成本分析和可靠性与LLM评价的统一框架联系起来。

blocks.en: B.2 Broader Evaluation Surveys
blocks.zh: B.2 更广泛的评价调查

blocks.en: Broader surveys map the LLM evaluation landscape rather than focus on cost reduction. Chang et al. organize tasks, benchmarks, and evaluation protocols ( Chang et al., 2024 ) , while Laskar et al. review evaluation methods and practical challenges such as computational demands, dataset subsampling, and human evaluation costs ( Laskar et al., 2024 ) . Ni et al. catalogue 283 benchmarks and analyze their design and limitations ( Ni et al., 2025 ) , whereas Chen et al. examine contamination-resistant static and dynamic benchmark design ( Chen et al., 2025 ) . Sheikhi et al. synthesize evaluation paradigms, benchmark lifecycles, and methodological weaknesses ( Sheikhi et al., 2026 ) . Ibrahimoglu et al. present a comprehensive taxonomy and discuss lightweight benchmark subsets, adaptive evaluation, early stopping, and cost analysis ( İbrahimoğlu et al., 2026 ) . Table 9 recognizes these contributions while distinguishing broad coverage from systematic treatment of evaluation efficiency. We count a dynamic or living benchmark as adaptive only when outcomes from the current target guide later acquisition or stopping. Our survey places less emphasis on cataloguing tasks and benchmarks and instead examines methods that reduce evaluation cost by testing fewer items, benchmarks, or human judgments while preserving reliable scores, rankings, or model-selection decisions.
blocks.zh: 更广泛的调查绘制了LLM评价景观,而不是侧重于降低成本。 Chang等组织任务,基准,评价协议(Chan等,2024年),而Laskar等. 审查评价方法和实际挑战,如计算需求、数据集分样本和人的评价成本(Laskar等,2024年)。 Ni等人编目283项基准并分析其设计和局限性(Ni等人,2025年),而 Chen等人审查了耐污染的静态和动态基准设计(Chen等人,2025年)。 Sheikhi等人综合了评价范式、基准生命周期和方法方面的弱点(Sheikhi等人,2026年)。 Ibrahimoglu等人提出了全面的分类学,并讨论了轻量级基准子集、适应性评价、早期停止和成本分析(Ibrahimoğlu等,2026年)。 表9承认这些贡献,同时将广泛的覆盖面同系统处理评价效率区分开来。 我们只当现行目标指南的结果后来获得或停止时,才将动态基准或活基准视为适应性基准。 我们的调查较少强调对任务和基准进行编目,而是审查通过测试较少的项目、基准或人类判断来降低评价成本的方法,同时保留可靠的分数、排名或模式选择决定。

blocks.en: Appendix C Taxonomy Guide

blocks.en: The taxonomy provides a consistent framework for reading, organizing, and counting studies. Its levels address a sequence of questions, and each paper receives one primary label. Other relevant properties are recorded as secondary attributes.

blocks.en: C.1 Scope
blocks.zh: C.1 范围

blocks.en: This subsection defines which studies enter the taxonomy and how they are labeled. We consider a method benchmark compression if it starts from a predefined full evaluation and evaluates fewer costly units, such as items, benchmark runs, human reviews, judge calls, comparisons, or agent rollouts. It may select all units in advance or choose them adaptively using observed results. From these units, the method must estimate the full-evaluation score or ranking, quantify uncertainty in that estimate, or reproduce the full evaluation’s decision. Reducing evaluation cost must be a central goal. Benchmark Analysis and Foundations includes studies that examine benchmark redundancy or compressibility, or assess the accuracy, reliability, and validity of compressed evaluations. We exclude broader work on efficient inference or evaluation unless it meets these criteria. We assign each paper a primary label based on the main problem it addresses, as reflected in its research question, stated goal, formal guarantees, and central experiments. Method components, titles, names, and application settings do not determine the label. A new short benchmark qualifies as compression only if the study explicitly tests its agreement with the predefined full evaluation. If the method changes what the benchmark measures or seeks to improve the benchmark while allowing scores or rankings to change, we classify it as benchmark repair or related analysis.
blocks.zh: 本分节定义了哪些研究进入了分类以及它们如何被标记. 我们考虑一种方法基准压缩,如果它从预先确定的全面评价开始,并评价成本较低的单位,例如项目、基准运行、人文审查、法官呼叫、比较或代理推出。 它可以提前选择所有单位,或者根据所观察到的结果进行适应性选择. 从这些单位来看,该方法必须估计全面评价得分或排名,对估计中的不确定性进行量化,或复制评价的全部决定。 降低评价费用必须是一个中心目标。 基准分析和基础包括审查基准冗余或可压缩性,或评估压缩评价的准确性、可靠性和有效性的研究。 除非符合这些标准,否则我们排除关于有效推论或评价的更广泛工作。 我们根据其研究问题、既定目标、正式保证和中央试验中反映的主要问题,为每份文件指定一个主要标签。 方法组件、标题、名称和应用程序设置不决定标签。 只有当研究明确测试其同意预先确定的全面评价时,新的短期基准才有资格作为压缩。 如果该方法改变基准衡量或力求改进基准,同时允许分数或排名改变,我们把它归类为基准修复或相关分析。

blocks.en: C.3 Decision Path
blocks.zh: C.3 决定路径

blocks.en: The decision path applies the rules in a fixed order to prevent secondary mechanisms from determining the primary label. Contribution type. First, we distinguish operational methods that reduce evaluation cost from studies that directly analyze benchmark compression or reliability. Operational methods proceed through the remaining branches. Analytical studies are labeled Benchmark Analysis and Foundations, while work outside both scopes is excluded. Adaptive evaluation. Next, we ask whether results obtained during the current evaluation can alter subsequent tests, budget allocation, or stopping. Methods centered on what to test next are labeled Adaptive Item Selection. Those centered on when to stop or what final action to take are labeled Sequential Decision and Stopping. Benchmark scope. For non-adaptive methods, we ask whether a method jointly reduces evaluation across multiple benchmarks or tasks. If so, it is labeled Cross-Benchmark Compression. Applying the same method separately to several benchmarks does not qualify. Single-benchmark information. We classify the remaining methods by the information essential to their operation. Benchmark content yields Content-Based Compression, past model results yield Historical-Response Compression, and a low-cost signal from the current model yields Target-Conditioned Compression.
blocks.zh: 决定路径以固定的顺序应用规则来阻止次要机制决定主标签. 贡献类型。 首先,我们将降低评价成本的业务方法与直接分析基准压缩或可靠性的研究区分开来。 业务方法贯穿其余分支。 分析研究被贴上基准分析和基础的标签,而两个范围之外的工作则被排除在外。 适应性评价。 其次,我们询问在本次评价期间取得的成果是否能够改变随后的测试、预算拨款或停止。 以下一步测试什么为中心的方法是被标记为"适应性项目选择". 那些以何时停止或采取何种最后行动为中心者被标为顺序决定和停止。 基准范围。 对于非适应性方法,我们询问一种方法是否共同减少了对多个基准或任务的评价。 如果是,则标为Cross-Benchmark Compression. 将同一方法单独适用于若干基准没有资格。 单基准信息. 我们根据对其运作至关重要的信息对其余方法进行分类。 基准内容产生基于内容的压缩,以往的模型结果产生历史反应压缩,以及来自当前模型的低成本信号产生目标条件压缩.

blocks.en: This ordering reflects the structure of the evaluation process. Adaptivity comes first because current results can change both the test sequence and the stopping point. Among non-adaptive methods, methods that jointly reduce evaluation across multiple benchmarks are separated before single-benchmark methods are classified by their essential information source. When a paper combines several mechanisms, its research question, main objective, principal guarantee, and core experiments determine the primary label. Other mechanisms can be described through secondary attributes.
blocks.zh: 这一命令反映了评价过程的结构。 适应性第一,因为当前的结果既可以改变测试序列,也可以改变停止点. 在非适应性方法中,在单一基准方法按其基本信息来源进行分类之前,将跨越多个基准共同减少评价的方法分开。 当一篇论文结合了几种机制时,其研究问题,主要目标,主要保证,和核心实验决定了主标签. 其他机制可以通过次级属性来描述.

blocks.zh: C.4 次要属性

blocks.en: C.5 Boundary Cases
blocks.zh: C.5 边界案件

blocks.en: Method properties can overlap, so Table 12 clarifies the criteria for common boundary cases. Two authors reviewed these cases using the scope criteria and decision path defined above. Ambiguous assignments were resolved through discussion based on each paper’s main contribution and evaluation design. Each paper received one primary label, while other mechanisms were captured as secondary attributes.

blocks.en: D.2 Selection and Recovery
blocks.zh: D.2 甄选和恢复

blocks.en: Selection determines both what to evaluate and whether to continue. Table 13 separates these controls because adaptive selection need not imply early stopping. PromptEval uses a fixed sparse design, while TailoredBench uses a limited probe to select one main batch ( Polo et al., 2024a ; Yuan et al., 2025 ) . Under the convention in Appendix C.5 , the latter is Target-Conditioned Compression. Adaptive evaluation instead lets main-stage outcomes change later tests, allocation, or stopping. UCB-E updates allocation within a fixed budget, whereas CELEUS stops when its interval reaches the requested precision ( Zhou et al., 2025a ; Zhou et al., 2026b ) . Fixing the main batch does not make the full two-stage design statistically nonadaptive or its ordinary mean unbiased. Probe reuse must be stated and its cost counted once. These execution patterns can span a single benchmark or a suite. Batch and Rounds describe dependencies between tests, with parallel execution still possible within a round.

blocks.en: Recovery determines what the selected observations support. Table 14 compares mechanisms that can be combined within a method. An appropriate random design lets a sample mean estimate the reference mean. Cluster weights on deterministic representatives do not provide the same protection. Probability weighting requires valid sampling probabilities and adequate support, with concentrated weights increasing variance. Predictors can use historical responses or fit current sparse observations, as in PromptEval ( Polo et al., 2024a ) . Their reliability depends on fit and transfer to the target. Residual correction instead uses observed reference errors to adjust predictions, as in CollabEval ( Fisch et al., 2026 ) . Under the method’s sampling and estimation conditions, inaccurate predictions can reduce precision and savings without invalidating the corrected estimate. Recovery must retain the unit identities, selection probabilities, and test history it needs. Valid stopping remains a separate requirement.
